Descriptions.Text: No restriction: the effect's defensive fields apply to hits on any body part.

Only the effect's defensive fields (damage cut rates, poise damage cut, SA receive damage rate, damage correct rates) only count for hits on body parts of group 6. Vanilla: Highroad Guardian left hand, Land Octopus beak, Lake crayfish weak point.

Only the effect's defensive fields (damage cut rates, poise damage cut, SA receive damage rate, damage correct rates) only count for hits on body parts of group 7. Vanilla: Highroad Guardian right hand.

Only the effect's defensive fields (damage cut rates, poise damage cut, SA receive damage rate, damage correct rates) only count for hits on body parts of group 8. Vanilla: Highroad Guardian left leg.

Only the effect's defensive fields (damage cut rates, poise damage cut, SA receive damage rate, damage correct rates) only count for hits on body parts of group 9. Vanilla: Highroad Guardian right leg.
